Review body

Two problems in this change need fixing before it can merge.

1. The CSV export leaves out the header row, so a spreadsheet treats the first row of data as the column names and that row of data is lost from view (src/export.ts:31).
2. The export guide says exports run every night, but the code only exports when someone clicks the button, so readers will wait for a nightly export that never runs (docs/export.md:8).

Please add the header row to the export and change the guide to say that exports run on demand when someone clicks the button.

Thread reply

Yes, it does now. The export writes a header row with the column names before the first row of data, so a spreadsheet no longer mistakes your first record for the column names. The test that checks for the header row passed in CI.
